items.t: Internal water pump leaks coolant into the oil
items.job: Replace internal water pump and timing chain parts, flush oil and coolant
items.note: If coolant already reached the bearings, an engine replacement can cost $5,000-$8,000.

items.t: AWD power transfer unit leaks and overheats
items.job: Reseal or replace the AWD power transfer unit
items.note: Low end is seals and fluid; high end is a replacement unit.

items.t: Automatic transmission slipping or failing
items.job: Rebuild or replace the automatic transmission

items.t: Takata passenger airbag inflator can rupture (do-not-drive recall)
items.note: Free at a Lincoln dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Driver airbag inflator can explode (recall)
items.note: Free at a Lincoln dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Fuel tank seam can rust and leak (recall)
items.note: Free at a Lincoln dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Brake booster can fail (extended warranty)
items.note: Free if your VIN is still within the extended warranty. Ask a Lincoln dealer first.

items.t: Door ajar light stays on and drains the battery
items.note: Price is per door.

items.t: Power steering fluid leak at the pressure hose
items.job: Replace power steering pressure hose and refill fluid
items.note: A worn-out pump adds $300-$700.

items.t: Front halfshaft can come loose (recall)
items.note: Free at a Lincoln dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: "Not in Park" warning and roll-away risk
items.job: Replace shifter assembly or Park switch

items.t: Engine stalls or loses power while driving
items.job: Diagnose stalling and replace throttle body
items.note: A purge valve or wiring repair can cost less.

items.t: Front brake hoses can rupture (recall)
items.note: Free at a Lincoln dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Rear brake hose can rupture (recall)
items.note: Free at a Lincoln dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Seat frame can damage airbag wiring (recall)
items.note: Free at a Lincoln dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Battery cable can short against shifter bracket (recall)
items.note: Free at a Lincoln dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Door striker bolts may be too short (recall)
items.note: Free at a Lincoln dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Harsh or jerky shifts from the 8-speed automatic
items.job: Reprogram transmission computer; valve body if needed
items.note: Software updates are normally free under warranty. Valve body or transmission work costs more out of warranty.

items.t: Instrument cluster may stay blank (recall)
items.note: Free at a Lincoln dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Transmission fluid leak from start-stop accumulator (recall)
items.note: Free at a Lincoln dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Backup camera image blank or stuck on (recalls)
items.note: Free at a Lincoln dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: 2.7L ticking or tapping on cold start
items.job: Inspect and repair per Ford bulletin (parts vary)
items.note: Often covered under the powertrain warranty; cost depends on the parts the bulletin calls for.

items.t: AWD chatter or shudder in tight turns
items.job: Rear drive unit fluid change or clutch service kit

items.t: AWD rear drive unit low on oil can seize (recall)
items.note: Free at a Lincoln dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Backup camera image delayed, frozen or blank (recall)
items.note: Free at a Lincoln dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Intake valves can break in the 2.7L engine (recall)
items.note: Free at a Lincoln dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Upper engine knock from the left cylinder head
items.job: Inspect and repair left cylinder head valvetrain per Ford service message
items.note: Usually a warranty repair on these newer models.

items.t: Rear shocks may be built wrong (recall)
items.note: Free at a Lincoln dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Power windows may not reverse on an obstruction (recalls)
items.note: Free at a Lincoln dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Engine block heater can overheat when plugged in (recall)
items.note: Free at a Lincoln dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Camera and driver-assist features drop out (recall)
items.note: Free at a Lincoln dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Center screens go blank or reboot (recall)
items.note: Free at a Lincoln dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: EGR valve can fail and cut engine power (recall)
items.note: Free at a Lincoln dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Headlights or other lights can go out (recall)
items.note: Free at a Lincoln dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.
